sources.title: Discover the world of WILD LIFE | schleich®
sources.snippet:
Adventure is up ahead! In the forests, savannahs, and jungles of schleich® WILD LIFE, kids and grown kids can discover the wild animals of the world. Our wild animal figures and playsets transform every playroom into a wilderness in the blink of an eye! At the adventure station, the rangers have a watchful eye on the endangered species of the African savannah – lions, zebras, rhinoceroses, and other wild beasts. Meanwhile, their ranger friends from the animal rescue are on a mission in the [...] on a mission in the depths of the jungle. With the help of a truck, an off-road vehicle, and a helicopter, they head out to see dangerous crocodiles, majestic elephants, and wild orangutans. Bring the wilderness home for your schleich® fan now with the most realistic wild animal toys roaming the planet! [...] The wild monkeys are swinging through the trees. The sloth barely manages a tired smile! Come on a walk through the dense tropical rainforest and discover its inhabitants!
